entry.title: Brazil's Biggest Bitcoin Exchange Says It Will Refund Users After a $40 Million Hack
entry.summary: Mercado Bitcoin says customers won't pay for a hack that drained tens of millions. Withdrawals on the exchange remain frozen with no restart date.

entry.title: Elon Musk’s Tesla and SpaceX Block Their Stock From OKX-ICE Tokenized Venue
entry.summary: Amazon, Tesla, SpaceX, Netflix, Lam Research, and SoFi objected to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 56.

entry.title: Five Ways North Korea Breaks Into Crypto Firms—and How Binance Was Hacked
entry.summary: From AI deepfakes to poisoning code libraries: here's how North Korean hackers get inside crypto companies.

entry.title: Epidemic of Hacked Freezers Spreads Across Europe
entry.summary: A suspected hacking wave has pushed supermarket freezers into defrost mode across ten European countries, with temperatures reportedly hitting 50°C. Nobody knows who's behind it or why it spread.

entry.title: UK Says AI-Powered Ransomware Attack on Critical Infrastructure 'Highly Likely' by 2028
entry.summary: The National Cyber Security Centre said AI will expose security flaws "tolerated for far too long," and called time on "tech on the cheap."

entry.title: Ethereum Privacy Network Aztec Rolls Out Major Security and Speed Upgrade
entry.summary: The “Tierra” upgrade resolves a critical bug from the prior version, adds formal verification, and an AI-powered testing harness.

entry.title: Morning Minute: Tom Lee Calls the Binance Hack Bullish for Ethereum
entry.summary: Meanwhile, both the BTC ETFs and ETH ETFs bleed outflows in the Binance hack aftermath, dragging down prices.

entry.title: Binance Misses Monthly Luna Classic Burn for First Time Since 2023
entry.summary: LUNC holders are waiting for Binance’s November burn, but it hasn’t arrived as the exchange recovers from a record $6.3 billion hack.

entry.title: Liquid Network Restores Full Bitcoin Backing Two Months After $320M Exploit
entry.summary: Blockstream CEO Adam Back said the sidechain's defenses have been hardened, and warned developers not to trust AI-suggested fixes blindly.

entry.title: North Korea Denies $6.3B Binance Hack, Calls FBI Finding a 'Political Provocation'
entry.summary: Kim Yo Jong suggested the U.S. itself could be behind the theft, as Binance said hourly deposits had begun to exceed withdrawals.

entry.title: Claude Fable 5.5, GPT 6.2 Astra Could Be Right Around the Corner, Leaks Suggest
entry.summary: Users say Claude is routing some requests to a stronger unreleased model, a Mythos 5.5 label appeared in Anthropic’s site code, and OpenAI appears to be testing GPT-6.2 Astra.

entry.title: Bitcoin Firm Strive Climbs Up the Treasury Ranks With Another Big Buy
entry.summary: Strive added 124 Bitcoin for about $10 million and now trails Twenty One Capital by 390 BTC for third place among Treasury companies.

entry.title: Mystery $106 Million Crypto Theft Hits EU Entity Days After Binance Hack
entry.summary: Onchain investigator ZachXBT says an unidentified EU entity lost more than $106 million from centralized exchange accounts on Sunday,.

entry.title: Claude-Built Linux Exploit Targets Bug That Ubuntu Still Hasn't Patched
entry.summary: Anthropic says Claude wrote an attack that can take over a Linux server with no password. Red Hat patched on Sunday, but Ubuntu still has no fix.

entry.title: Tom Lee Calls Bottom on AI Stock Selloff, Citing Tight Supply and Crypto Resilience
entry.summary: The Fundstrat strategist says constraints on AI spending have slowed growth without ending the boom, while crypto’s response to the Binance hack suggests sellers may already be exhausted.

entry.title: North Korea Is Laundering Binance Hack Loot at One New Wallet Every 25 Seconds
entry.summary: $2.85 billion of the $6.43 billion stolen from Binance has been frozen or seized, compared with about 3% in the Bybit hack, as North Korea’s automated laundering spans 12,000 wallets.

entry.title: Proton Users Revolt After CEO Calls Security Caution 'Loser Thinking' Amid AI Push
entry.summary: Proton customers say they are canceling subscriptions after reports of pressure to adopt AI coding, as the privacy company scraps employee re-interviews but defends its broader shift toward automated development.

entry.title: Nvidia and Nike Lead Biggest Wave Yet of Tokenized Stock Objections
entry.summary: Nvidia, Costco, Nike and nine other companies objected to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 50.

entry.title: Elon Musk Mocks Sam Altman Over Claim Home PCs Are Wasting RAM
entry.summary: The OpenAI CEO said it's "quite terrible" for DRAM to sit largely idle in personal computers while AI data centers face a supply crunch.

entry.title: Brazil's Largest Exchange Mercado Bitcoin Halts Withdrawals After $40 Million Hack
entry.summary: Brazil's largest crypto exchange paused deposits and withdrawals after a security incident. Tether froze more than 4.5 million USDT tied to the attack.

entry.title: Bitmine Buys More Ethereum as Tom Lee Calls the Binance Hack Bullish
entry.summary: The chairman laid out six reasons the market’s “muted” 4% ETH drop after the record Binance theft shows crypto is “increasingly resilient,” as the firm’s stash neared its 5% supply goal.

entry.title: How T7X Is Building the Infrastructure for a New Era of Capital Markets
entry.summary: T7X records ownership directly on-chain instead of wrapping assets held elsewhere, keeping token and asset under one legal framework.

entry.title: Morning Minute: Binance Hack Leads to Mass Outflows While FBI Opens Probe
entry.summary: Uptober was far from it, with the Binance hack punctuating a red month. Will November be better? Or will the Binance hack hang over crypto?

entry.title: Strategy Resumes Bitcoin Buys With $66M Purchase
entry.summary: The Bitcoin treasury firm also spent $208.2 million buying back its STRC preferred stock, cutting its USD Cash balance to $132.7 million.

entry.title: BTCPay Tells Merchants to Switch Off Servers Amid Hot Wallet Attack Reports
entry.summary: The Bitcoin payment software says attacks targeted versions 2.4.1 and older, days after it shipped an emergency fix for a critical flaw.

entry.title: FBI Blames North Korea for $6B Binance Hack as Exchange Reopens Withdrawals
entry.summary: Binance saw $3.64 billion in net outflows in the first nine and a half hours after reopening withdrawals, or 2.1% of its assets, it said.

entry.title: Bitcoin ETF Investors Head for the Exits After Record Binance Hack
entry.summary: Bitcoin ETFs saw $643.2 million in outflows Friday, the first full trading session after the $6.4 billion Binance hack, ending October with roughly $516 million in net outflows.

entry.summary: Free tools like Ollama and LM Studio can run open-weight AI models on your laptop, offline, and without a subscription. Here's how to get started.

entry.summary: Attackers tied to North Korea drained roughly $6.4 billion from the world’s largest crypto exchange. Here’s what we know about how it happened, who’s behind it, and what comes next.

entry.summary: From boat-racing bots to OpenAI models inside Hugging Face, here's how AI reward hacking works and why it matters.

entry.title: Binance Hack Shows Why Offshore Exchanges Need US Oversight, CFTC Chair Says
entry.summary: Michael Selig said the record $6.4 billion theft shows why offshore exchanges should register with the CFTC and adopt U.S.-grade cybersecurity standards.

entry.title: Intel Stock Suffers Worst Crash in 50 Years as Weak Forecast Overshadows AI Chip Demand
entry.summary: Intel beat third-quarter earnings expectations, but warned of a prolonged PC slump, sending shares to their worst daily decline in 50 years.

entry.title: Worried About Crypto Hacks? Buy Bitcoin Proxies in Stock Market Instead, Say Wall Street Firms
entry.summary: Analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald, TD Cowen and Compass Point say the record $6.4 billion theft is a Binance security failure, not a crypto-wide threat, pointing clients toward proxies like Coinbase, Robinhood, and Strategy.

entry.title: Reddit Stock Plunges 30% as Google's AI Search Hits Traffic and User Growth
entry.summary: Reddit shares are down 44% this week after CEO Steve Huffman warned that Google's AI-powered search features are cutting referrals, while weaker user growth and disappointing fourth-quarter guidance added to investor concerns.

entry.title: Binance Hack: Why Bitcoin Didn't Crash Like It Did in 2018
entry.summary: Binance lost about $6.4 billion, the largest crypto hack on record, yet Bitcoin fell about 3%, against nearly 11% in 2018 when the exchange was last attacked.

entry.title: $8 Million Crypto Kidnapping Lands Texas Brothers 15-Year Prison Terms
entry.summary: Raymond and Isiah Garcia held a Minnesota family at gunpoint for more than nine hours, forcing the father to transfer over $8 million in crypto, in one of the clearest “wrench attack” prosecutions yet.

entry.title: Secret Service, FBI Join Binance Hack Probe as Circle Freezes $823 Million
entry.summary: Binance says it has set aside $6.34 billion to cover losses from the breach and the FBI and Secret Service are now working with the exchange as investigators trace the stolen funds.
